description: C5: stock delta-v readout (VesselDeltaV in Ship mode) in the EDITOR for the three PhysProf craft and the 14 stock craft of harness confignode_roundtrip/corpus. Each craft is loaded with EditorDriver.StartAndLoadVessel (facility from the craft folder) or EditorLogic.LoadShipFromFile; for each situation body (Kerbin, Mun, Duna, Eve; altitude 0) DeltaVGlobals.DeltaVAppValues.body/altitude are set, VesselDeltaV.SetCalcsDirty(false) is called and values are read after GameEvents.onDeltaVCalcsCompleted. Masses are tonnes (float32 as KSP stores them), thrust kN, Isp s, burn time s.

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
